I bought this and so far it has been great. I just got the mini to try but I will purchase the big one when I run out.

I'm a 43 year old Black woman and I love this eye cream. I've noticed a difference in both my dark undereyes and puffiness. I love the way it feels and it doesn't take much to for my skin to feel hydrated and moisturized. It's a been addition to my routine

I received this about two weeks ago ( well 9 days ago). I have been desperate to find something for my dark circles and puffiness under my eyes. So far I'm not seeing any change at all. I am not giving up yet and going to keep using it. I will update my review when its been a month.

avis.titre: Use ream in the undereye area ONLY if milia prone
avis.texte: I tried the Bright + Brew-tiful Eye Cream because I have dry eyelids and undereye bags with slight discoloration. I liked that the cream has good slip and feels very comfortable in the eye area. Ingredients include vitamin C to brighten the appearance of dark circles, banana-tinted powder for instant radiance, and a 3% caffeine blend to help help visibly depuff tired-looking eyes. I had been applying about dots of the cream on my eyelids and under eye area and while I noticed some eye brightening and depuffing, I also started getting some milia (tiny white bumps) on my eyelids. I saw that dimethicone is the fifth ingredient in this eye cream and think my overzealous use of the product over my entire eye probably caused the milia. I stopped use of the eye cream to give my condition a chance to resolve itself and it did. Now I only use less than one dot of the eye cream just in my undereye area. I have yet to find an effective treatment for dry eyelids without the potential for milia. A tiny amount of this eye cream is fine and safe to use for the undereye area but don't overuse if you are milia prone.

I bought a mini size because the under eye cream I have been using went up in price again. I wanted to find something new. I absolutely love this product. It has a nice thick consistency and absorbs into your under eye skin and doesn't leave any residue. This is better than the product I have been using for the past 3 years and about 5 times less expensive. A little goes a long way. I will be purchasing this product again.
I love how this feels. I am 45 and have struggled with dark bags all my life due to sinus issues
Seems like an easy everyday eyecream, I guess it will take time of use before the brightness appears.
It feels nice on the under-eye but it is kinda slow to work. Definitely takes a few weeks of this every morning.

I've purchased the Elf Holy Hydration eye cream many times so when I saw this new version with caffeine I really wanted to try it. Ive used it for the past 2 weeks and really love the formula. It's hydrating and brightening. Ive had no issues with applying under makeup. Elf Skin products have really impressed me!
I received this product about a month ago and have been using it daily with Elf's vitamin C + E serum and I love it! Very hydrating and brightening!
I tried others brands in the past, but this one is a game changer!!

The most notable thing about this product is how much it pills! I literally would see little orange flecks of product underneath my eyes and trying to rub them away only exacerbated the issue! Very difficult to use concealer over this product—even when allowing ample time to dry—because of this pilling issue. This product *maybe* brightened my under eye area a bit, but not enough to outweigh the pilling. I used consistently for a month or so but don't think I'll use again.
I love this! I'm 54, with the normal amount of wrinkles and lines and this makes my eyes feel very good

I think this eye cream is great. It goes on smooth and feels light. Doesn't sting or "tingle" (otherwise known as stinging). Wakes up my 50 year old eyes and sets the stage for concelor. It is affordable and overall a nice product.
Haven't used much yet as I just received my order, but on initial use I think I'm going to really like this product.

A nice feeling moisturizer that "brightens" by leaving a subtle goldish pigment on the skin. It is subtle. Pros: did not dry, irritate, or cause milia and texturally nice feeling. Big Con: caused pilling with 3 different concealers I tried.

I got this in exchange for a review. I LOVE how it feels whipped when I put it on, almost like it has tiny whipped bubbles that are popping? I'm not really seeing much of an effect at all, but I'm thinking maybe I haven't had enough time to use it before reviewing. Time will tell!

Normally I love ELF products but this one gave me a very bad skin reaction and made my eyes puffy, red, and the skin became infected or very irritated so much so that I had to get a prescription cream. If your have sensitive skin I would not recommend this product.

I received a free sample. The cream was easy to apply and blended easily into my skin. I appreciated the light but pleasant scent. After a few days of use i saw the brightening effects under my tired eyes. I also appreciated the ease of blending with my makeup. There was no oiliness. would definitely try this product again.
*I received this in exchange for a review.* I love it. It goes on light and smooth. I use it every morning as part of my daily routine now. Will definitely be buying more!

e.l.f. kindly provided me with this product for free in exchange for an honest review. The e.l.f Bright + Brew-tiful Eye Cream is a decent alternative to similar products I've tried. The issue with these products is that they are minimally helpful. My biggest challenge is with puffy under eyes. This eye cream works ok with that, but not great. I'm still on the hunt for a real good one. This cream does do a nice job with lightening the area where you apply it. And it has a wonderful, silky texture with no smell at all. That is good for avoiding the unpleasant or mediocre smell of other products. Particularly, my husband hates when I apply certain types of products to my face because they sometimes have unusual scents. If you are looking for an eye product that goes on nice and smooth and you're more concerned with lightning that area versus depuffing that area, this is a great product for that. I like putting it all over my face just because it's so silky smooth. I would buy this product for lightning dark areas on the face, but not for reducing puffiness around the eyes. I'd recommend it to friends and family with the same caveat.
I really love this cream. It applies nicely and absorbs well. Leaves my under eye area much improved.
I have tried it and it was ok. It didn't leave my face feeling oily. It was easy to put on. I would recommend it. It is a very good addition to my routine.

avis.titre: Almost refreshing, but effects don't seem to last
avis.texte: I received the E.l.f. Bright + Brew-tiful Eye Cream for free through the BzzAgent sampling program, and heres my honest take on it. I've been using the cream every morning for a few weeks now. The texture is smooth, and it absorbs quickly, which I LOVE. It gives my eyes a nice, refreshed feeling in the morning, which is great when I haven't had much sleep. The cream has a nice, light scent, which is a fun touch and definitely adds to the "waking up" vibe. Compared to other eye creams I've tried, this one feels a bit lighter and doesn't leave a greasy residue, which I appreciate. A lot of other creams I've used are either too thick or too oily, but this one feels refreshing without feeling heavy. However, I haven't noticed the same long-term benefits, like reducing dark circles or keeping my eyes hydrated throughout the day. The main benefit I see with this eye cream is that it gives an immediate boost to tired eyes, especially in the morning. If you have an issue w/ puffiness or just need something to wake you up a bit, this may be a good option. Plus, its pretty affordable, which ofc very important. That said, I don't think I'd buy it again. It works great for a quick fix in the morning, but the effects don't last all day, and I was hoping for something with a bit more lasting power. If you're looking for something that will keep you feeling fresh all day, this probably isn't it. I'd recommend it to a friend who needs a morning pick-me-up, but I'd let them know it's not goin

Took my puffiness away very quickly. Love the smell and feel of the cream as well. Didnt make my eyes sting or feel irrigated. Even if i wouldnt have gotten it free to try i would hvae bought it to try as all elf product are a great bang for your buck!

I got this product and I was honestly surprised by how well it actually worked! It goes on easily and doesn't leave a film or residue. I found this product brightened my under eye and didn't value my makeup. It's also a great amount of product so this should last a while.
This eye cream is so nice and hydrating. It would be nice if it was for the whole face. Overall a great product!
This is a new permanent part of my morning skincare. It feels great and is nice and lightweight.

avis.titre: Works great for under eye puffiness
avis.texte: I purchased this product because I seem to wake up with under eye puffiness, after using this product for three weeks, I did notice a significant decrease in puffiness. It's lightweight and you just need a small amount. The only bad thing that I can complain about is it does seem to peel under make up so if you wear heavy make up this product is not for you.

Been using this for a few weeks now and it's honestly become a staple in my morning routine. The texture is really creamy but absorbs fast, so it doesn't leave that greasy film behind. Major bonus points because it plays nice with my concealer—no pilling at all. ​It definitely helps with that morning puffiness and makes me look a little more awake, though I wouldn't say it drastically changes my dark circles. If you have super dry skin, you might want something thicker for nighttime, but for a daily daytime eye cream, it does the job well.

As with most e.l.f. products I love this! It does give off the appearance of a brightening affect once you put it on. Very light weight and blends well. Not that I have much dark circles, so I can't say for sure if it does truly lighten over time because I haven't had it long but it does do the job.

I received this eye cream to try and after a week here is my opinion. The amount you need to apply in your is small. My eye area absorb the eye cream fast and don't feel heavy. After I use the eye cream I continue with my makeup and I don't see that the eye cream affect the application of my concealer. Feel great eyes look a little brighter but I need to continue using for more time to really see the results. But for know I love it. The smell is almost noticeable but it's perfect.

I find it to be hydrating, but it doesn't stand out compared to other eye creams that I've used in the past. It is very affordable, so that's a plus. I would recommend this product if you're looking to try something new at a reasonable price.

It is very light weight and absorbs fairly quickly. Only issue is the pilling under makeup. It didn't feel heavy or greasy to me me either.

This eye cream feels lightweight and absorbs quickly compared to others I've tried. It helps brighten my under-eye area and makes my eyes look more awake without feeling heavy or greasy. I like that it works well under makeup and is very affordable. I would buy this product again and would definitely recommend it to friends or family looking for a budget-friendly eye cream. Although I was gifted this item to review, I stand by my comments and recommendations.

As for the brightening, I can't say I noticed much but I don't have much darkening around my eyes neither. Overall, I would recommend to those needing a solid affordable eye moisturizer.
Leaves my skin feeling super soft, and brighter! Would absolutely buy again!

I received this product free to try in exchange for an honest review. I enjoyed using this product. I liked that is it lightweight, a good value, and the size allows me to travel with it. My only complaint is that I feel like it is not quite as long lasting as other products I have used in the past. I feel like I have to apply it more often. avis.titre: A gentle morning wake-up that still works at night
avis.texte: I received this for free in exchange for my review. I've been using the E.L.F. Bright + Brew-tiful Eye Cream for a bit now, and it's honestly such a pleasant surprise. The texture is light, sinks in quickly, and makes my under-eyes feel fresh and hydrated without any heaviness. I love it in the morning to look more awake, but I've also been using it at night; it layers well with the rest of my routine and leaves my under-eyes feeling soft by morning. It's not a miracle product, but for the price, it's simple, comforting, and effective.

I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review. I was very excited to receive it as I was running out of my strivectin eye cream product and hadn't found a replacement. I tried to use it for 2 weeks and there was no difference in the appearance of my dark under eyes and it constantly caused both my nars concealer and Charlotte setting powder to ball up and not sit right. I'm glad I didn't use my own money to purchase this product. I switched to an ROC eye product and it's been a game changer.

avis.titre: A morning latte for your under-eyes!
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review. I've been using e.l.f.'s Bright + Brew-tiful Eye Cream for a couple of weeks now, and it has quickly become a morning staple. The texture is lightweight and quick-absorbing, perfect for layering with other products. The scent is refreshing without being overpowering, and it gives that little "wake-up" moment I want from an AM eye cream. Compared to other budget-friendly eye creams I've tried, this one feels more hydrating and brightening. My under-eyes look smoother and more awake, especially on early mornings. After consistent use, I've noticed my under-eye area looks more even and less dull. I would purchase this again, and definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a lightweight, affordable eye cream that actually delivers a brighter, refreshed look.

This eye cream actually works. It instantly brightens with a subtle banana tint, visibly depuffs, and makes my under-eyes look awake even on zero sleep. The texture is lightweight, absorbs fast, and sits perfectly under concealer without creasing. Over time, my dark circles look softer and more even. For the price, the results are impressive—this is now a permanent part of my morning routine.
Brightened, smooth and soothed under eyes! I really like this product.

avis.titre: Amazing hydration and brightening eye cream
avis.texte: I have always been obsessed with E.L.F. products because of the affordability, accessibility, and of course how well everything works so I was not surprised trying out this eye cream that provides amazing hydration, brightens m eyes and dark circles, kind of like a built in color corrector with the banana they use in this cream. Best value for my money and great choice for my eyes! I absolutely recommend getting it and adding it to your beauty routine! I was lifted this product in exchange for my honest review.
I have dryness and dark circles around eyes. I am excited to try this.

As someone with naturally dark under-eyes, I'm always on the hunt for a product that can truly brighten and help me look more awake. I've tried countless creams and serums over the years, so I made sure to use this cream consistently at night for two weeks. The texture is definitely a highlight. It's creamy, easy to apply, and doesn't dry down in a strange or heavy way. I also appreciate the clean, sleek packaging. Unfortunately, despite consistent use, I haven't noticed any visible brightening in my under-eye area. While the skin does feel softer and more hydrated, it hasn't made a noticeable difference in reducing the appearance of my dark circles. Because of this, I wouldn't personally repurchase the product. I think it could work well for someone looking for a gentle, moisturizing under-eye cream, but I wouldn't recommend it to friends or family who are specifically trying to target dark circles or want noticeable brightening results.
This cream is super creamy and rich plus it doesn't clog pores. However I didn't notice too much of a brightening effect.
I enjoyed this bright + brew-tiful cream a lot! it has a semi-thick cream like texture that kept my skin feeling hydrated and smooth. I would definitely purchase again!
This is good cram. After using it for two weeks I can tell that I like it. Considering to buy more. I receive this cream for testing in exchange on review.

I have been using this every day and I find it to be very moisturizing. It absorbs quickly and has a nice soothing effect. The texture is creamy but light and the packaging is very simple. Very nice product and a step up from the original eye cream. So far, loving it!

This ice cream is very hydrating and makes my under eyes look a lot better. It really brightens the under eye making you look more awake and refreshed. I do have sensitive skin and this has not bothered me at all.
Good eye cream, really well moisturizing and hydrating under eye area. Grate price and you need just tiny amount for one application so it will last for a while.

The caffeine and vitamin C give a nice refreshed look, and for the price, it's definitely worth having. I would buy it again and I'd recommend it to friends and family looking for an affordable everyday eye cream.
This is comparable to another brand that is much more expensive. I think this product works and i have added it to my daily routine now. Its a very smooth texture and feels frest.

I recently purchased this eye cream. So far, it has been providing moisture. I am not sure about brightening effects because I've only been using it for about a week.

avis.texte: This is a free product I received from elf and bzzagent for my honest review. I have very dark under eyes, and this eye cream is perfect for me. It has caffeine and vitamin C to brighten the darker areas, and it I did see some improvement. The consistency is thick so I love it, and it is also scent-free for sensitive skin. What I most love about this eye cream is that it doesn't sting in the eye at all, and it helps moisturize and prep for concealer.

I received this produce for free in exchange for a review! This eye cream smells good, feels light and smooth on my skin, and showed a difference in two weeks. My dark spots under my eyes were lighter, and I had smaller bags. They are still slightly baggy due to my lack of sleep. Lastly, my skin looks brighter! I would recommend and buy this product!
I like it. I like to use it before i put on makeup and it helps my under eyes look smoother and nicer! I think this is a good product

I'm very satisfied with this eye cream so far, and am excited to see the results as I continue using it with more time. The cream feels nice on my skin when I put it under my eyes, and soaks into my skin well. There is a very faint scent, but it's not really noticeable which I like. It feels very moisturizing, and leaves the skin feeling soft. I've already noticed my fine lines around my eyes improving, and it's also helped with my dark circles. I like that it has caffeine in it because I think it's a big attribute. I have a hard time finding skin care products that really work, and am pleased to say this is one of them that shows results. I received this product free in exchange for my honest feedback.

I really loved this product. The caffeine plumped up my eyes and helped with the bags under my eyes. It worked great with all my other skincare and worked great under makeup. This eye cream is very moisturizing for my dry skin and helped my under eye skin look less dry with concealer.

This is a very good eye cream with Vitamin C. It will not remove my under-eye darkness, as this is part of my facial structure. It is hydrating and has not caused any irritation on my sensitive rosacea-prone skin.

I did not see any difference while using this product. I was hoping for any improvement. I do have fine lines and wrinkles under eye.

I purchased the mini to try out, and I've been using this for over a week, only a little is needed to pat on. The results for me where instant It's lightweight, hydrates, brightens and really makes my under eye circles less noticeable! Worth getting the regular size! I definitely recommend!
I received this as a sample in exchange of my honest opinion. This is a great daily item for individuals with dry skin and surprisingly has lasted 8+ hours.
I have enjoyed this product so far. It is hydrating and I do feel like it helps with puffiness dark circles. I would recommend to other shoppers.
I got this from a sample website, it wasn't a scam product, it is the middle of winter tell me why it came leaking everywhere, good product though

I do find that it minimizes the look of the undereye circles, and I like it because it doesn't have a strong smell. I received a sample of this product to provide an honest review.

If you need deeper moisture or stronger anti-aging, it might feel a bit basic - but for freshening up tired eyes in the morning, it works.
It's a great affordable option for an eye cream- happy that I tried it

I got the mini size to try out before purchasing and it goes on smooth and doesn't sting like other creams on the eyes I think I finally found something that works for me it feels hydrating and refreshing on my eyes it's become part of my cleansing routine

I've been using this product regularly. As soon as you pat it on, it immediately blurs out undereye darkness and brightens your face. I purposely waited to review this, to ascertain its longer term effects. After a few weeks, my undereye bags are practically nonexistent, and the area appears firmer and brighter. A little definitely goes a long way. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this product.

I've received this product for free in exchange for an honest review! Love this product! Have to be consistent to notice results but improved my under eye area

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. The Elf Bright + Brew-tiful Eye Cream instantly gives a cooling feeling that awakens my eyes. I have been using this every morning for a few weeks now, and my eyes are left feeling hydrated and I'm left feeling happy knowing this contains vitamin C. At little goes a long way with this cream so this is going to last a while. I really like how affordable this cream is, I don't have to break the bank.
The texture is silky, no scent that I've noticed. I never expected it to work so quickly, I saw results after first use, I'm impressed. I will be buying again!

I've been using this eye cream for at least two weeks, and have notice that it instantly brightens and hydrates my under eyes. This formula absorbs quickly, gave a bright awaken appearance to my eyes, and helped depuff the undereye area specially when I had tired eyes. Is also a good option to use under makeup as it leaves the eye area smooth and hydrated. As for dark circles I haven't notice a huge difference yet, but it's affordable and would recommend.
I received this as a sample and it was wonderful. It's light enough to go under my foundation and isn't greasy at all.

I bought the mini size so I could try it first before spending more for the larger size. Thank goodness I did! I was shocked by how tiny the product was for how pricey it is, even at the mini size!
